scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn src.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy src
scripts.format: npm --workspace frontend run format && cd backend && uv run ruff format .
scripts.format:check: npm --workspace frontend run format:check && cd backend && uv run ruff format --check .
